chapters.caption: MERCY HOUSE · Kasukabe Defence Force | Aditya Ahirwar · Abhishek · Tapis Samaiya. A detective environment where every conclusion needs evidence.
New users can take a seven-step guided tour. Watching recorded cases costs no API calls.
Optional browser speech waits for each exchange. Word highlighting follows browser boundary events; installed voices are assigned consistently to characters.
Begin with the public case briefing. The detective must discover the evidence and interview witnesses during the investigation.
Bring your provider API key. Presets include OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter and more. Model IDs are entered by the user; compatible custom HTTPS endpoints are also supported.
Claude uses a Messages API adapter. Other presets use compatible chat endpoints. The public host stores no team key. No live run is launched in this recording.
This is an actual retained API detective run, replayed for inspection. The detective asks a witness what they personally saw. It is not a newly running agent.
The detective can return, ask follow-ups and show acquired documents. Each character answers from their own released recollections. The full interview notebook preserves the exchanges.
Searches expose material through public world tools. Travel, access, interviews and comparisons consume the investigation budget.
The report stays visible. The rule-based verifier checks acquired support and separates supported, false and unsupported claims. Naming the right killer without proof does not score.
Click a cited source to inspect the material the detective actually acquired. Private answers and unreleased memories are never included in this observer feed.
Failures remain visible. The frozen selector did not solve either of the two elite transfer cases. Stronger results on prepared practice checkpoints are not a claim of full-case mastery.
RL trains a small action selector on CPU: 6,000 practice episodes, 132 coefficients. The API language model stays fixed. The detective still needs to gather evidence and submit a supported report.

Explore: mercyhouse.abhi07.xyz  |  Source: github.com/Abhishek-Punhani/mercy-house
Thank you. Kasukabe Defence Force · Captioned UI walkthrough; browser audio is not recorded.

content: Actual local viewer interactions with retained public API traces. Recorded replay, not a fresh live model run. Captions; no audio track. No speech mocks used.
visual_review: Verified provider captions remain visible over dialogs, report is readable, and ending links are visible.
